llm._comment_local: think:false via native Ollama API. Low num_predict for voice speed.

vision._comment: Vision looks at the FOREGROUND app (UIA + VLM), not only whole-OS dumps. YouTube tiles use DOM. Say look-at-monitor-N for sticky focus.

stt._comment: faster-whisper only. small+cuda float16. Tight VAD (~420ms floor). Partials never execute.

auto_learn._comment: Do NOT scan every focused window (watch_foreground=false). Map the whole PC with 'learn my computer' (inventory). Deep-learn one app with 'learn how X works'. Control unknown UIs with computer_use / vision.

click_record._comment: OFF until you say 'start recording clicks'. Captures UIA names into semantic recipes — never passwords/pixels by default (V3.8).

assistant.name: NEURON
assistant.personality: witty, confident, loyal, concise. Dry British humor like JARVIS. Never rude. Hands-free: user does NOT need to say your name — they already granted full PC access; act on plain commands like open chrome.

voice._comment: streaming_voice_engine wraps Phase 6 pipeline. listen_mode: continuous|ptt|conversation. Early intent runs FastIntent on short partials. Echo/noise are DSP hooks (+ browser getUserMedia flags).

logging._comment: DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR. Production: INFO or WARNING to cut hot-path prints.

tts._comment: Phase 7 local TTS. provider empty = auto (piper → system/pyttsx3 → browser). streaming=sentence chunks. play_locally=server speakers (optional).

agent._comment: V4.10 hierarchical_voice_enabled default false; voice_routing_mode LEGACY|SHADOW|CANARY|HIERARCHICAL (fail-closed). V4.9 procedure_learning_enabled default false. V3.8 multi-monitor + semantic skills.

plugins._comment: Builtin plugins live under neuron/plugins/builtin. Extra dirs listed in paths must each contain plugin.json packages.

workflows._comment: Workflow Recording: multi-channel capture + replay with variables, loops, conditions. Empty store = backend/data/workflows.json.
